statusLegend.leading: Frido is the #1 Bestseller-badged product on the tracked keyword.
statusLegend.ranked: Frido holds a Bestseller badge or top-10 organic rank, but is not #1.

statusLegend.no-match: A brand-qualified search was run and Frido has no product that genuinely fits this category — a verified gap, not a research miss.
statusLegend.needs-verification: Evidence is incomplete or a live check was blocked — do not treat as absent.
